title: Agentic Sandbox Egress Firewall & Secret Broker Selection: Zero-Trust Out-of-Sandbox Credential Injection vs. Raw Env Vars & L3 Allowlists

workload_basis.threat_vectors: Indirect Prompt Injection (Markdown Image Exfil, DNS Tunneling, print(os.environ), Allowed-Domain GitHub/S3 POST Exfil)
workload_basis.agent_type: Enterprise Coding Agent & Tool-Using Workflow Sandbox

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Unrestricted Outbound Egress + Raw API Keys in Container os.environ
Tier 2: L3/L4 IP & DNS Allowlist (Cilium NetworkPolicy) + Raw Secrets in os.environ
tiers.recommended_scenario: Insufficient (attackers exfiltrate os.environ secrets via allowed github.com / s3 domains)

tiers.tier: Tier 3: L7 Forward Proxy (Envoy/Squid Method + Path ACL) + Short-Lived Scoped Tokens
tiers.recommended_scenario: Baseline enterprise sandbox with repo-scoped fine-grained tokens

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Out-of-Sandbox L7 Secret Broker (Zero Raw Keys in Sandbox) + Path/Method ACL + CSP img-src Sinkhole
tiers.recommended_scenario: Production Coding Agents & MCP Sandboxes (0% raw token exposure, 99.8% exfil blocked)
